title: Historic Route 66 · New Mexico
direction: New Mexico's Route 66 includes both the 1926 alignment that loops north through Santa Fe and the later cutoff across to Albuquerque, so this strip follows the loop, with the eastern section toward Santa Rosa and Tucumcari as a branch.

sources.driveTimes: OSRM (router.project-osrm.org), OpenStreetMap data, computed at build time; excludes stops and traffic
